# Check coverage: what each guard prevents, and what it is blind to

Each rule is "prevented by" a named check. A blind spot is a way the rule can be broken
without that check noticing; reviewers cover blind spots by hand. Edit `.agents/checks.toml`
(factory-managed) or `.agents/checks.local.toml` (repo-owned), then run `julia scripts/gen.jl`.

| Rule | Prevented by | Runs in | Test | Blind spots |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| No destructive git/rm commands, no pushes or GitHub actions without the user, no writes outside the repo root, only read-only commands inside the read-only roots of .agents/factory.toml | `.claude/hooks/bash_guard.sh` | hook PreToolUse(Bash) | `scripts/test/test_hooks.jl` | commands built at runtime (eval, variables, $(...), aliases, scripts, julia/python -e); `cd` to a computed target (`cd "$D"`, `cd -`, `cd` in a subshell or `sh -c '...'` string) is not followed; read-only roots: a program in the root started by path from outside it (`sh ~/ref/run.sh`, `python ~/ref/x.py`), tools that find a project by a path argument or env var (`--manifest-path`, `UV_PROJECT`, `JULIA_PROJECT`), symlinks into a root; the read-only allowlist trusts its tools (`less` can run `!cmd`; `git log/diff --output=f`, `rg --pre`, `git -c core.pager=...`); subshells, `popd` and `cd -` are not unwound, so `(cd root && ls); make` counts `make` as inside the root (a false positive, never a bypass); quoted arguments containing spaces (and a quoted ` > /abs/path` inside a message is a false positive); heredoc detection assumes `<<WORD` and a terminator line equal to WORD; tools that write through their own config (Pkg depot, uv cache); Bash run outside Claude Code |
| Edit/Write tools never write outside the repo root, and never touch T3 protected paths without approval | `.claude/hooks/write_guard.sh` | hook PreToolUse(Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit) | `scripts/test/test_hooks.jl` | writes made through Bash (bash_guard covers only part); symlinks inside the repo pointing outside; T0-T2 paths (left to scripts/dod.jl at merge); a session started inside factory/template runs the TEMPLATE's hooks with the template as root (the denial says so; dispatch lanes from the repo root); guards fail closed when their script is missing only if settings.json itself is intact |
| A teammate does not go idle without reporting | `.claude/hooks/teammate_idle.sh` | hook TeammateIdle | `scripts/test/test_hooks.jl` | cannot see whether a SendMessage report was sent; the second idle passes either way; plain subagents (no TeammateIdle event); fails open without jq |
| At most [lanes] max_open subagent lanes are open per session | `.claude/hooks/dispatch_limit.sh` | hook PreToolUse(Agent|Task) | `scripts/test/test_hooks.jl` | teammates may not emit SubagentStart/Stop (UNVERIFIED), so they may not be counted; a crashed subagent with no SubagentStop stays counted until the session changes; Workflow-tool fan-out is not counted |
| Every subagent start and stop is recorded in the lane ledger | `.claude/hooks/lane_ledger.sh` | hook SubagentStart, hook SubagentStop | `scripts/test/test_hooks.jl` | fails open (no jq, unwritable .lanes/); records ids only, not outcomes |
| Compaction does not lose the branch, open lanes and dirty files | `.claude/hooks/precompact.sh` | hook PreCompact, hook SessionStart(compact) via .claude/hooks/session_start.sh | `scripts/test/test_hooks.jl` | decisions that exist only in the conversation; re-injection relies on the SessionStart `compact` matcher (documented, not yet observed here) |
| The pre-compaction snapshot is put back into context after compaction | `.claude/hooks/session_start.sh` | hook SessionStart(compact) | `scripts/test/test_hooks.jl` | prints at most 40 lines; a stale snapshot from an earlier compaction is printed if precompact failed |
| Generated agent files, AGENTS.md, the PR template, protected paths and this table match their sources | `scripts/gen.jl` | ci Guards, local scripts/ci.jl guards | `scripts/test/test_gen.jl` | prose quality of bodies and CLAUDE.md; whether agents follow their bodies |
| A PR links a spec/plan (or is T0), changes tests with src/, adds a CHANGELOG entry, and has an ADR when T3 | `scripts/dod.jl` | ci Guards (pull_request) | `scripts/test/test_dod.jl` | that the linked spec matches the change; that the changed tests test the changed code; review approval (left to branch protection); a mislabelled PR below the path-derived tier is raised, but one above is trusted |
| Coverage floor only rises, size budgets and benchmark tolerance only fall, files stay within budget | `scripts/ratchet.jl` | ci Guards, ci CI (coverage, with --lcov), local scripts/ci.jl guards | `scripts/test/test_ratchet.jl` | compares with the merge base only, not every parent of a merge; files not matched by any size glob; coverage of code that is never loaded |
| Markdown links and backticked repo paths point at files that exist | `scripts/check_docs.jl` | ci Guards, local scripts/ci.jl guards | `scripts/test/test_check_docs.jl` | paths outside the known prefixes; anchors (#section); command flags named in docs; the CONVENTIONS list in check_docs.jl is trusted even where a repo never creates those paths; files excluded and references allowed by .agents/factory.toml [check_docs] (and fenced blocks when ignore_fenced = true); in a checkout holding the factory, a path in factory/*.md that exists only in factory/template/ passes even if it was meant as a repo path |
| USED.md's contract IDs each have exactly one real contract test item and are live (not retired) in the upstream contract file, and every upstream name the code uses that a `names:` line covers has its ID listed | `scripts/contract_usage.jl` | ci Guards, local scripts/ci.jl guards, /contract-check | `scripts/test/test_contract_usage.jl` | names reached through a bare `using Upstream` (no qualifier) or generated by macros; rule-only entries (no `names:` line) the code relies on without listing them; that the test item actually checks the contract's statement; a vendored contract file older than the coordinator's (refreshed by /contract-check, not by CI); names in strings containing `#`, and multi-line `using Up: a,` lists; names reached through a module alias (`import Up as U`, `const U = Up`); names mentioned in docstrings count as used; `tags = [:contract]` written on a line after the `@testitem` line |
| Workflows call only jobs that scripts/ci.jl defines, so CI and local runs share one command list | `scripts/ci.jl` | ci (every workflow), local | `scripts/test/test_ci.jl` | workflow steps that are not ci.jl calls (setup, cache, upload, TagBot); the upstream-main contract run is UNVERIFIED end to end |
| Worktree lanes live at <repo>/.worktrees/<lane>, within the cap, and are removed only when clean and merged | `scripts/lane.jl` | local scripts/lane | `scripts/test/test_lane.jl` | `--allow-ignored` deletes ignored files the caller did not copy out; worktrees made with plain git worktree add; EnterWorktree lanes under .claude/worktrees/ |
| Factory updates arrive deliberately: shown as a diff, local edits never overwritten silently, version recorded | `scripts/sync_factory.jl` | local | `scripts/test/test_sync_factory.jl` | a `local-modified` managed file stops receiving factory updates until the edit is reverted or --force is used; seeded files (CLAUDE.md, risk.toml, ...) are never updated after the first sync; their diff is only shown |
